engine.notes: Baltimore runs on two institutions: BIG's Station North theatre and Highwire's new Highlandtown center, which between them cover classes, jams and most of the weekly shows; MidAtlantic Improv and Points North's First Fridays fill in at breweries and galleries. The Charm City Comedy Project's domain has lapsed to spam.

entries.name: Baltimore Improv Group (BIG)
entries.summary: Nonprofit improv theatre founded 2004, in its own Station North theatre since 2017, with shows Thursday to Saturday by house teams such as The McGuillacuddies and Snake Oil, a free Grateful Jam and a 101-to-501 class track.
entries.schedule: Shows Thu-Sat; seven-week levels 101-501 ($285-$305); free Grateful Jam; October 8-17, 2026 shows listed
signals: Own theatre at 1727 N Charles St since 2017
Free Grateful Jam open to all
entries.reasons: Twenty-two years, a theatre of its own, three show nights with house teams, a complete five-level track and a jam, with October 2026 dates on the site.

entries.name: Highwire Improv
entries.summary: Improv company founded 2020 that opened The Highwire Center in Highlandtown's former Hoehn's Bakery in October 2025, with weekly shows, a community jam, free grant-funded intro workshops, Foundations classes and visiting-artist workshops.
entries.schedule: Weekly shows; Short Form, Huge Fun community jam; free two-hour intro workshops; John Lutz workshops Oct 16-17, 2026
signals: The Highwire Center opened October 2025 in Highlandtown
Free intro workshops backed by a Maryland State Arts Council grant
Foundations classes plus skill modules, in person and online
Weekly shows and a community jam
Classes also offered with Everyman Theatre
entries.reasons: Six years old but now in a room of its own with a dense October 2026 calendar, free intros and a levelled start; beyond Foundations the ladder is modules rather than numbered levels.

entries.name: MidAtlantic Improv
entries.summary: Touring improv company performing and teaching across the DMV since 2016, best known for Law & Order SIU: Special Improv Unit, now in a regular 2026 run with Area 405, plus a seasonal improvised Christmas Carol.
entries.schedule: Law & Order SIU regular performances in 2026 with Area 405; brunch editions at Guilford Hall Brewery
signals: Law & Order SIU: Special Improv Unit
2026 partnership with Area 405 for regular shows
entries.reasons: A decade-old company with a signature show and a 2026 residency, but no venue, no public class track and undated listings on its own site.
